title: Beyond The Text: Analysis of Privacy Statements through Syntactic and Semantic Role Labeling
reasoning: The paper utilizes the Contextual Integrity (CI) social theory framework to define a new task for extracting information parameters from privacy policies. While CI is a framework used for reasoning about privacy norms, the paper focuses on the technical task of parameter extraction and model evaluation rather than benchmarking or evaluating religious, moral, or ethical reasoning systems themselves.
